name: com.tencent.qcloud.tuikit.tuicallkit.view.component.floatview.FloatWindowService
description: During a Tencent Cloud TRTC TUICallKit call, this Service shows a movable call panel over other screens when overlay permission is available. Tapping the panel returns to the call screen.
disableEffect: The floating call controls will not appear over other apps, removing this shortcut back to an active call.
